settings.title: Size guide
settings.content: 20″ × 10″ fits most cats and small-to-medium dogs; 27″ × 13″ is perfect for bigger pups. The tie-on style adjusts to any neck.

settings.title: Care instructions
settings.content: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle and hang to dry — the botanical print stays vivid wash after wash.

settings.title: Shipping & production
settings.content: Every bandana is printed to order just for your pet, so please allow a few extra days for production before dispatch.

settings.giveback_text: Printed to order for your very good pet 🐾
